Every confirmed fatal finding on content this run may write carries a fixed disposition, including the Step-7 adjudication repairs, so the run's own drafted carriers form a closed, review-complete set. The one live exception is cross-library and read-only: rows deferred against published mathematical suppliers - the classical Stokes theorem carrier with its companion Stokes and Green suppliers, and the alternating-map definition - which physics cannot repair and which need mathematics-library maintenance or an exact real-consumer context disposition; physics carriers that consume those suppliers should be read as relying on the retained statements only. Empirical carriers remain source-qualified reports whose confirmed repairs restored conditions, controls and citation fidelity rather than proving any framework. The only remaining actions are the owner's recorded ones: the personal mathematical audit, the deliberate publication status changes, and push/deployment. This response interprets the packet and does not change publication state.

Consumer exposure: physics carriers declare the flagged Stokes/Green items as mathematical premises - for example pthm-em-integral-maxwell, pthm-em-motional-emf and lem-em-moving-flux - so their provenance stays coupled to those suppliers until the mathematics side applies the recorded corrections. The packet's fix text indicates the statements can be retained, but this interpretation does not independently re-derive that correction.

Headline defect totals are not live-defect totals: the ledger's fatal figures include superseded historical rows, including rows recorded open before their current deferred successors replaced them. Only active rows without a fixed disposition are live findings, so the raw fatal count should not be read as an inventory of open problems.

Step-7 audit trail: the Step-7 adjudication coverage rows carry notes stating that the exact original reason is retained in evidence without a new mathematical classification or verdict. Auditing those findings therefore depends on the bound evidence artifacts, not on the ledger row text alone.

Empirical qualification: the experiment posts and the fringe/apparatus examples are source-qualified observations; their confirmed repairs (battery conditions, sensitivity control, wire increments, title scope, apparatus identifiability) restored fidelity to the cited records and must not be read as converting reported agreement into proof of any framework.

Repeat-repair marker: a cluster of items across the SR foundations and the EM conventions and worked examples went through two recorded repair rounds. All carry fixed dispositions, but repair history is where residual risk concentrates, so these are the natural sample-audit targets.

Display-only metadata quirk: the packet's items_by_kind listing separates quoted kind keys (for example "definition") from the plain names. These are magnetostatics-family carriers that store their frontmatter scalars quoted; parsed kinds are identical, so this is a histogram artifact rather than a kind mismatch, and normalizing the quoting would prevent further confusion.
